system.description:
• Effect: After 5 rounds of study and concentration, determine whether an item is magical. A successful Intelligence check reveals the magic's origin (Aldorethi craft, divine creation, alchemy, etc.) — requires having previously encountered that type of magic.
  • From 18th level: also reveals the item's relative power (great or small) and its importance to a people, culture, or historical entity

activities.name: Detect Magic
activities.text: After 5 rounds of study, reveal the origin of an item's magic if you have met that kind before.
